bibliographic.title: Conduit of the Crypt
bibliographic.author: Grim Baccaris
bibliographic.description:
A tiny text-based dungeon made in Twine for the Neo Twiny Jam. I pared this idea way down to make it playable within 500 words, and I had a lot of fun getting it there. 

  • ⏳ 500 words, ~5 minutes to play
  • ⚔️ Knight appearances are randomized from a pool of 7 sprites by @Calciumtrice.
  • 🩸 There are a few ways to (cause your vessel to) die in this game, complete with crunchy sound effects.
  • 🎧 Headphones recommended! 🔊
  • 🖱️ Mouse or trackpad recommended to see the neat background effect, but not essential.
  • 📱 Playable on mobile!
